about: The counts at the head of docs/OPEN-PROBLEMS.md, each with the item it belongs to. npm run docs:open-problems runs them (sql against dist/h2c.sqlite, the others against the committed build snapshot) and writes the table; round:close checks it. Only the raw and compiled tables are asked, never the record tier, which only a checkout with the private cache holds.

counts.label: Products you can buy (active procurement grades)
counts.sql: select count(*) from grades where status = 'active' and role = 'procurement'

counts.label: Products with no nozzle temperature from any source
Products with no bed temperature from any source
Products whose heated-chamber check is unanswered
Products with a price of their own
counts.sql: select count(distinct gradeid) from prices where quarantined = 0 and headline_sample = 1

counts.label: Materials with a price
counts.sql: select count(distinct materialid) from prices where quarantined = 0 and headline_sample = 1

counts.label: Published values physics rules out, kept and flagged
counts.sql: select count(*) from measurements where data_status = 'Published value (physically implausible)'

counts.label: Values whose unit or layout cannot be read
counts.sql: select count(*) from measurements where data_status = 'Unresolved unit / layout'

counts.label: Recorded conflicts waiting on a maker
counts.sql: select count(*) from coverage where status in ('Conflict', 'Quarantined')

counts.label: Sources not retrieved in full
counts.sql: select count(*) from sources where access_state <> 'retrieved'

counts.label: Measurements more than three robust deviations from their material's others
counts.sql: select count(*) from v_measurement_z where abs(z) > 3

counts.label: Coverage findings standing as a gap or a limitation
counts.sql: select count(*) from coverage where status in ('Gap', 'Limited comparability', 'Reviewed with limitations', 'Partially resolved')
